pages: ceil(first known target rank / page size)
search_work_proxy: baseline pages versus 2 * helper pages; equal per-index work assumption, not measured CPU/time
stopping_assumption: An oracle recognizes the first known target; no actual agent verification is measured
independence: Already observed docstring proxy questions from three repositories, not an independent final evaluation
purpose: Measure page-cost labels before choosing a new training loss. No model promotion or LLM savings claim.
